# JSON to TypeScript Interface Generator

> A free, open-source tool that converts JSON objects into TypeScript interfaces instantly in the browser. No signup required.

## What it does

Paste any valid JSON into the input and receive TypeScript interfaces as output. Supports nested objects, arrays, and optional export keyword. The root interface name is configurable.

## Usage

- URL: https://json2ts.vercel.app/
- Input: Valid JSON (paste or type)
- Output: TypeScript interface declarations
- Options: Toggle `export` keyword, set custom root interface name

## Example

Input JSON:
```json
{"name": "Alice", "age": 30, "address": {"city": "NYC"}}
```

Output TypeScript:
```typescript
export interface Address {
  city: string;
}

export interface RootInterface {
  name: string;
  age: number;
  address: Address;
}
```
